description.en: Institutions, state formation, trade, coercion, and industrial development in historical perspective.
description.zh: 从历史视角阅读制度、国家形成、贸易、强制与工业发展。

description.en: Commitment, political agency, conflict, signaling, and beliefs through formal models.
description.zh: 通过形式模型理解承诺、政治代理、冲突、信号与信念。

description.en: Poetry, anthologies, interpretation, and comparative reading, including Chinese literary traditions.
description.zh: 围绕诗歌、选本、阐释与比较阅读展开，兼及中国文学传统。

description.en: Probability, statistical inference, econometrics, and real analysis: concepts, results, and proof techniques.
description.zh: 概率、统计推断、计量经济学与实分析中的概念、结论和证明方法。
